item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.su: The ancient contract lets you contain blight, but also burdens you with resentment...
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.cu: Curse of the contract: it cannot be removed, and even death cannot undo this eternal covenant.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.bl: Ancient Blight: the ancient corruption dulls the edge of your blade.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.an: Accept the burden of blight willingly, and Ferin will answer you.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.bl: Elder Warrior's Blight: the fatigue of long battle leaves you frail and unable to mine effectively.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.an: Stop the village guardian who has lost his reason, and Groth will answer you.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.bl: Guardians' Blight: battle-worn madness consumes you and leaves gaps in your armor.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.an: Wear the feelings the sisters could never express, and Silva and Siegrid will answer you.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.bl: Knight Captain's Blight: heavy honor weighs on you, making you fear battle and robbing you of the strength to run.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.an: Kill the blighted king who stained honor, and Julius will answer you.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.bl: Mad Knight's Blight: endless battle clouds your mind, weakens your sword arm, and makes you bleed freely.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.an: Sleep while embracing the gifted flower and tear, and Ulv will answer you.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.bl: Dark Witch's Blight: giving everything to protect another leaves you lost, without magic, and struggling in water.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.an: Care tenderly for the weary heart, and Eleine will answer you.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.bl: Abyss Guardian's Blight: malice hidden in the shadows leaves you panicked and unable to resist its corruption.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.an: Show him your resolve to remain undefeated in spite of it all, and Hoenir will answer you.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.bl: Heretic's Blight: grief across the divide seals your senses, leaving you unable to face encroaching corruption.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.an: Complete the cure he could not, and Faden will answer you.
item.purified_undead.ancient_contract.ta: The little White Priestess's prayer strengthens your resistance. Though your body is frail now, purifying more blight will make it ever stronger (%s/%s).
item.purified_undead.blighted_spirit.use: While the contract is equipped, hold use to consume %s and upgrade the White Witch talisman.
item.purified_undead.ferin_warrior.summa: The purified blight left by the ancient warrior.
item.purified_undead.ferin_warrior.effec: Ferin turns aside the Ancient Blight for you: melee damage rises by 30%, and melee damage dealt by you or Ferin restores 20% as health.
item.purified_undead.groth_warrior.summa: The purified blight left by the Elder Warrior.
item.purified_undead.groth_warrior.effec: Groth shelters you with a veteran's resolve: take 20% less damage while grounded, gain +0.5 critical damage multiplier, and jump attacks can stun for 3 seconds.
item.purified_undead.julius_warrior.summ: The purified blight left by the Knight Captain.
item.purified_undead.julius_warrior.effe: Julius turns honor into forward momentum: gain +1 attack reach, 20% sprint speed, and continuous Hero of the Village III.
item.purified_undead.former_ornament.sum: A feather entwined with a Blighted Spirit; hold it under Slow Falling and the Guardians will answer the contract.
item.purified_undead.guardian_warriors.s: The purified blight left by the two Undead who guarded the White Priestess.
item.purified_undead.guardian_warriors.e: The sisters grant 5 armor and 10% armor, 10% armor toughness, 2 blocks of additional safe fall distance, 50% less fall damage, a double jump, and one dash per airtime.
item.purified_undead.snow_flower.summary: Hold the Snow Flower in the main hand and a Ghast Tear in the offhand, then complete a night's sleep for the Mad Knight to answer.
item.purified_undead.ulv_warrior.summary: The purified blight left by the Mad Knight.
item.purified_undead.ulv_warrior.effects: Ulv turns madness into a relentless assault: gain 20% attack speed; build 5 melee stacks within 5 seconds, then consume them for the full-stack bonus and 50% follow-up damage.
item.purified_undead.tired_heart.summary: Hold it in the offhand and personally kill three Drowned for the Dark Witch to answer.
item.purified_undead.eleine_warrior.summ: The purified blight left by the Dark Witch.
item.purified_undead.eleine_warrior.effe: Eleine answers your protection with magic: gain 30% magic damage, a 30% melee chance to launch an orb for 45% damage, and continuous Water Breathing underwater.
item.purified_undead.hoenir_warrior.summ: The purified blight left by the Abyss Guardian.
item.purified_undead.hoenir_warrior.effe: Hoenir shares the art of surviving the shadows: harmful effects last half as long, 5% maximum health is restored each second, and attacks deal 50% more damage while leaving a mark for Ferin to consume.
item.purified_undead.faden_warrior.summa: The purified blight left by the Heretic.
item.purified_undead.faden_warrior.effec: Faden broadens your craft through forbidden knowledge: effective Fortune and Looting each rise by 1, and direct attacks have a 20% chance to inflict Poison I for 20 seconds.
